verdict.rationale: Relay's docs and community evidence confirm automated account-to-account transfer rules (auto-transfer every deposit, cash cushion with automated rules) which covers the auto top-up/allocation piece of treasury automation, and this is corroborated by hands-on community feedback about automatic partitioning of money. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated low-balance alert feature being offered. missing for 10: explicit low-balance alert/notification capability, evidence of alerting thresholds, and independent confirmation of true 'auto top-up' (vs. one-way auto-transfer) behavior.
